output.summary: KEP-3294 proposes letting a PersistentVolumeClaim provision a volume from a VolumeSnapshot in another namespace, gated by a ReferenceGrant check performed by the CSI external provisioner or a separate populator. Its status is implementable at alpha stage.
output.rationale: Today a PVC can only use a VolumeSnapshot in its own namespace, and several KEPs need snapshots shared across namespaces. The proposal uses the ReferenceGrant CRD to restrict which cross-namespace snapshots may be consumed. Reviewers debated where the logic should live (external-provisioner vs. separate populator) and whether to add a VolumeSnapshotLink object or change the core API, and the sources do not record a final resolution of the core API question.

alternatives.option: Separate populator for alpha (lib-volume-populator or a forked provisioner)
alternatives.why_not: Xing Yang suggested it to avoid making external-provisioner more complicated, but msau42 preferred implementing in external-provisioner behind a feature gate because each driver would otherwise implement its own populator and another component must be released.

alternatives.option: Core API change: add a namespace-aware DataSourceRef field to PersistentVolumeClaimSpec instead of a VolumeSnapshotLink object
alternatives.why_not: ttakahashi21 noted it is a big core API change needing compatibility work; msau42 suggested starting with the SnapshotLink approach and revisiting later, so it was not adopted for alpha.

alternatives.option: Grant the PVC direct access to the Snapshot object (no SnapshotLink)
alternatives.why_not: The sources say DataSourceRef is a TypedLocalObjectReference that can only point to the same namespace, so a direct reference needs the core API change; the sources do not record a further reason beyond that.

evidence.quote: To restrict only allowed `VolumeSnapshot` to be consumed from other namespaces, [`ReferenceGrant` CRD (formerly `ReferencePolicy`)]
It's better to implement this as a separate populator in the alpha stage to avoid making external-provisioner more complicated.
I prefer implementing in the external-provisioner with a feature gate, which is what we've done with other features.
We would be able to change it to `ObjectReference` and allow direct access to PVC. It will be much simpler from UX viewpoint. However, it will be a big core API change
I think we should start with this approach initially. Once the ReferenceGrant model has been more proven then I think we can consider merging the two.
